race.comment: ACORN (4) resumes on the back of a trial win at Lark Hill after a solid campaign last time in. He bumped into the handy Mt Shirataku before the break and was a strong winner first-up as favourite. Will need a touch of luck from the draw, but he still has some upside. RIPPER FAROOQ (2) dropped the rider two back before getting the dream run last start and landing the knockout blow. Portelli's claim comes in handy and he'll be well positioned despite coming back to 1000m. Can feature in the finish once again. ARTIE'S ECLIPSE (11) led and beat the favourite last start at the midweeks in a solid performance. She drops in weight here and despite drawing awkwardly, she has the speed to offset the barrier. SCREAM (3) disappointed two back before a dominant win last start as an odds-on pop at Albany. Can bring that form to Ascot and feature in the finish.
